services.title: Three integrated services that run your business end to end
services.sub: Pick the service you need now. They all work together on one platform: your site takes orders and bookings, and accounting records them automatically.

svc.title: Websites & online stores
svc.desc: Your business online. We design a company website or online store in your brand: fast, mobile-friendly and ready to be found in search.

features.d: Your colors, logo and style on every page.
Products, sizes and colors, cart and order management.
Complete content in both languages, RTL and LTR.
Smooth on phone, tablet and desktop.
A structure that helps customers find you on Google.
Edit products, prices and photos from your dashboard.

svc.title: Booking system
svc.desc: A system that takes bookings around the clock and assigns them to your staff by service and availability, with no clashes or back-and-forth calls.

features.d: Customers choose the service, staff and time themselves.
Set the duration, price and provider of each service.
Per-staff schedules that block out-of-hours bookings.
Messages on booking and before the appointment.
Full appointment control from your dashboard.
Track today's and this week's bookings and revenue.

svc.title: Smart accounting
svc.desc: Simple, clear accounting that records sales, expenses and inventory in OMR, and issues tax invoices and financial reports.

features.d: Record every sale and purchase and track payments.
A clear view of where your money goes each month.
Control what each staff member sees and edits.

flow.title: Services that work together, no double entry
flow.sub: Everything that starts on your website flows automatically into bookings, inventory and accounting.

faq.title: Answers to common questions
faq.sub: Didn't find your answer? Contact us directly.

list.a: No. The interfaces are simple, and we set up the platform and train your team before launch.

list.q: Can I start with just one service?
list.a: Yes. Start with a website, store, booking or accounting, and add the rest later.

list.q: Can the store connect to inventory and accounting?
list.a: Yes. Orders update stock and create invoices automatically within the same platform.

list.q: Does it support Arabic and English?
list.a: Yes. Every interface is available in both languages, and your customers can choose.

list.q: Are invoices compliant with Oman VAT?
list.a: Yes. The system includes Oman VAT settings and issues tax invoices in Omani Rial.
Yes. Connections are encrypted, each business's data is fully separated, with staff permissions and regular backups.

list.q: Can I use a domain with my business name?
list.a: Yes. Your site can use a domain in your business name, and we help you register and connect it.
